races.name: Rootkin
races.blurb: Living trees from a forest moon. They put down roots and grow stronger the longer a fight goes on.
pros: Towers get stronger every wave they survive
Thorns and poison keep hurting after the hit
cons: Moving a tower throws away its growth
races.description: Tree-aliens armed with thorns, seed pods and strangling vines; every attack deals thorn damage. Every tower is rooted: it starts at 85% strength and gains +5% damage and +2.5% range for each wave it stands through (up to six waves), so a Rootkin line that holds early becomes the strongest in the game.
races.tagline: Grows into the game: weak saplings, unstoppable elders.

passive.name: Rooted
passive.description: Towers start at 85% damage and gain +5% damage and +2.5% range per wave they stand through, up to 6 waves.

races.name: The Assembly
races.blurb: A machine collective that strips worlds for scrap. Rapid-fire guns, heavy shells and long-range artillery.
pros: Guns fire faster the longer they keep shooting
cons: Guns cool down when the shooting stops
races.description: A machine collective with kinetic ordnance: nailguns, pile drivers, mortars, a railgun. Guns spin up — every shot within a second of the last makes the next one 6% faster, up to 30% — and kills pay 10% more scrap. The price: upgrades cost 20% more.
races.tagline: Burst and salvage: guns spin up, scrap pays, upgrades cost.

passive.name: Spin-up
passive.description: Each shot within 1 s of the last fires the next 6% sooner, up to 30%. Kills pay +10%. Upgrades cost +20%.

races.name: Chitin Swarm
races.blurb: An insect hive that overruns planets by sheer numbers. Cheap acid-spitting towers that are strongest packed together.
pros: Acid builds up on every target
cons: Selling a tower returns only half
races.description: Insectoid hive with acid weapons: spitters, jaws, webs, acid sacs. Towers are cheap and the hive links them — each other tower within 1.5 tiles makes a tower fire 10% faster (up to three) — and acid stacks three deep instead of refreshing. The price: a sold tower refunds only half.
races.tagline: Numbers and acid: cheap towers that are stronger together.

passive.name: Hive link
passive.description: Each other tower within 1.5 tiles: +10% fire rate (max 3). Acid damage over time stacks up to 3×. Selling refunds 50%.

races.name: Lumenari
races.blurb: Beings of living light. Few towers, but each is precise, sees far and can hit several enemies at once.
pros: Beams go through enemies to hit the ones behind
The first shot after a pause hits very hard
races.description: Energy beings: beams, pulses and time fields. Beams pierce through up to two creeps behind the target at half damage, and any tower that has waited 2 s opens with an overcharged shot at 2.5× damage. The price: everything fires 8% slower.
races.tagline: Few and precise: pierce the line, open with an alpha strike.

passive.name: Overcharge
passive.description: After 2 s idle the next shot deals 2.5×. Beams pierce 2 extra creeps along the line at 50%. Towers fire 8% slower.
